content.short: DeXe DAO Studio is a platform for creating and managing DAOs.
content.description: DeXe DAO Studio addresses the complexities and inefficiencies of traditional DAO models by making governance more accessible and straightforward for communities. At its core is autonomous governance, supported by a toolkit that enables diverse voting models, token delegations, and the creation of expert sub-DAOs. It also provides resources for drafting meta-governance proposals, strengthening collaborative decision-making and broadening participation in governance processes.
content.meta: DeXe DAO Studio enables autonomous governance with tools for voting models and token delegations. Discover DeXe DAO Studio and other DAO Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
